text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just before the Arima Kinen, Inari One 
feels more nervous and scared than ever 
before in her life. Yet, she thrills at 
the thought that this is precisely what 
makes it her true festival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her spirit simply refuses not to burn. 
Determined to show the essence of true 
festival swagger, she steps onto the stage 
of battle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Inari One like that, Oguri Cap and 
Super Creek noticed the change in her and 
smiled boldly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The decisive battle to divide the realm, 
the Arima Kinen. The grand festival of the 
Twinkle Series begins.
